evidence_against.relevance: Alex behaves warmly toward several group members and also makes one-on-one plans with other friends, reducing the distinctiveness of the behavior toward Jordan.
There has been no explicit romantic framing, romantic physical contact, or statement of romantic interest.
Alex postponed Jordan's proposed dinner twice and did not offer a replacement date within the next two weeks, which weakens the case for active special interest.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Alex initiated two one-on-one plans, which could indicate special interest.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea show personalized attention.
Repeated extended texting after group events suggests sustained interest in interacting with Jordan individually.

recommended_action.explanation: Because the personalized attention and the broader pattern of friendliness support competing interpretations, direct clarification would resolve the ambiguity more reliably than inference.

uncertainty_explanation: Facts C1-F1 through C1-F3 support possible special interest, but C1-F4 shows similar friendliness toward others, while C1-F5 and C1-F6 provide no clear romantic confirmation and some counterevidence. Neither interpretation is sufficiently better supported.
